# Processes

- [auth](auth.md) - Sign-up by emailed code, password or Google sign-in, then an HttpOnly cookie session (15-minute access JWT, rotating 30-day refresh token). (verified)
- [delta-sync](delta-sync.md) - Pull songs and albums into IndexedDB, then only records changed since the last marker. (verified)
- [local-playlist-upload](local-playlist-upload.md) - After sign-in, device-only playlists are uploaded once as private server playlists. (verified)
- [offline-audio](offline-audio.md) - Save a recording to IndexedDB on request; the player prefers the saved copy over the stream. (verified)
- [offline-writes](offline-writes.md) - Mutations made offline are queued in IndexedDB and replayed in order on reconnect. (verified)
- [publish-content](publish-content.md) - Admin uploads a song (with audio) or an album (with cover); both sides of the link are written. (verified)
